summary: This is a major push to bring Web Speech (the Web Speech API) into a modern, on-device model: the browser can now download and install local speech models (ModelHub/Parakeet), run recognition in a HWInference helper process, expose streaming confidence and timing events to the page, and handle installs with a permission prompt and AI Controls gating. The older online-only recognition code was removed and the API updated to match current specs; **this enables private, on-device speech recognition with explicit user consent** and better UI feedback during model download. Tests around model installs, aborts, multilingual backends, and performance were added to validate correctness.
